If your "Wake" button is failing, it's likely because the button is either not hitting the `bridge-waker` service, or the service itself is in a hung state. 

I want to look at `bridge-waker.mjs` to see exactly how it attempts to initiate a wake-up. If I can understand the signal it sends, I can help you bypass the broken UI link and trigger it directly from here.
